content.short: Minterest is a decentralised lending protocol that attracts and rewards long-term liquidity.
content.description: Minterest is a refined DeFi lending protocol that improves how lending works by fine-tuning auto-liquidations. This optimization enables Minterest to capture the full value of protocol fees and return that value to users as Governance Rewards. In turn, users are incentivized to stake MINTY tokens, fostering an ecosystem where longer-term participation increases voting weight and proportionally boosts reward allocations. Over time, committed participation enhances both influence and the rewards received by participants.
